# Grid402 (HTTP x402 v2 M2M Oracle)

> Zero-PII, machine-to-machine utility APIs for AI agents and automated pipelines, settled via HTTP 402 (x402 v2 USDC micropayments on Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, and Ethereum), Grid402 Session Pass (Pix, Card, or USDC), RapidAPI Hub (USD), and Model Context Protocol (/mcp with 30 tools). All endpoints emit ECDSA secp256k1 signed responses (`_oracle_proof` and `_meta`).

## Payment Options and Free Trials

- **HTTP x402 v2 EVM USDC Pay-Per-Call**: Supported networks include Base (`eip155:8453`, primary USDC contract `0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`), Polygon (`eip155:137`), Arbitrum (`eip155:42161`), Optimism (`eip155:10`), and Ethereum (`eip155:1`). Collector address: `0xa592625adbceb8e025ac383f1a3fd8ebb6a63f90`. Calls are priced from `0.0050` USDC to `0.0500` USDC (plus dynamic sums on `/api/v1/batch`).
- **Grid402 Session Pass (`/pass`)**: Prepaid bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer pass_g402_...` or `X-Payment`) for sub-15ms zero-gas calls. Tiers:
  - **Micro**: R$ 4.90 (50 credits / 5 KYB dossiers, 90-day TTL)
  - **Starter**: R$ 12.00 / 2.00 USDC (400 credits, 180-day TTL)
  - **Pro**: R$ 29.00 / 5.00 USDC (1,200 credits with 20% bonus, 180-day TTL)
  - **Fleet**: R$ 115.00 / 20.00 USDC (6,000 credits with 50% bonus, 365-day TTL)
- **Instant Free Promo (`MCPTRY50`)**: Claim 50 free trial credits with promo code `MCPTRY50` at https://grid402.online/pass (no crypto wallet required).
- **MCP Auto-Trial (`/mcp`)**: 30 MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 tools including a daily free MCP auto-trial (1 call/day per IP across paid utility tools before requiring `payment_proof`).
- **RapidAPI Hub (USD)**: Available via RapidAPI Hub billed in USD (`X-RapidAPI-Proxy-Secret` bridge; `/api/v1/dossier` enforces a 15 req/day safety cap on RapidAPI).
- **Sandbox / Demo Header**: Use `X-Payment: demo` (strictly rate-limited per IP; max 2 items in `/api/v1/batch`; cannot issue Session Passes).
